author: dragon_trappers_lodge
title: Hiring Concept Artist for Fantasy Miniatures
content: WE'RE HIRING: CONCEPT ARTIST! ⚔️ The position will entail creating 2d concept art for 3d printable fantasy miniatures. Concepts will need to be refined line art drawings. No rendering, color, or value work required. Typically no turnarounds required, occasional weapon or prop details may be needed. Often there will be multiple poses which will require loose sketches. We pay $100/concept with more complex detailed creatures granting more pay on a case by case basis. All applications must be submitted through our official BambooHR hiring page, linked in our bio. We do not accept applications, review portfolios, answer hiring questions, or conduct any part of the recruitment process through Instagram, including DMs and comments.

author: mrcharlesky
title: Hiring Graphic Artist and Video Editor
content: Hiring: 🎨 GRAPHIC ARTIST AND 📸 VIDEO EDITOR! Job Title: Graphic Artist (Freelance) The Role: You will work closely with our social media manager. We are not only looking for someone with a sharp eye for design but also someone meticulous with text placement (such as CTA) and image compositions that convert viewers into followers, players, wishlisters, etc. Moreover, we need someone who is proactive with design suggestions and reflects brand elements surrounding Philippine culture & tradition incorporated into our games. Key Responsibilities: - Create game content poster layouts and graphic images for social media use. Use digital illustration, photo editing software, and layout software to create designs. - Collaborate with the social media team and production team to develop creative solutions. -Follow brand guidelines, standard operating procedures (SOPs), and revision feedback efficiently. SEND YOUR CV & PORTFOLIO to: support@dalluyonstudio.com
